context.description: Context on the job that can be used in the functions {@link #map} and {@link #reduce}.

mapLambda.description:
Lambda to define the "map" part of the job.
The signature must match the one of {@link DynMapReduce#map}.

mapCompletedLambda.description:
Lambda to execute after the "map" part of the job is completed.
The signature must match the one of {@link DynMapReduce#mapCompleted}.

reduceLambda.description:
Lambda to define the "reduce" part of the job.
The signature must match the one of {@link DynMapReduce#reduce}.

completedLambda.description:
Lambda to execute after the "reduce" part of the job is completed.
The signature must match the one of {@link DynMapReduce#completed}.

failedLambda.description:
Lambda to execute when the job fails.
The signature must match the one of {@link DynMapReduce#failed}.

title: Shared fields to define a {@link DynMapReduce} and {@link DynMapReduceSpec}.
name: DynMapReduceLambda
